4th Period.workingNow: Finishing and polishing your About Me page — checking it has everything it needs.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A complete About Me page (copied from the Example file) with header/body structure, formatted favorites text, at least one image with a caption, and a table.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can check my About Me page against the requirements so that it's complete before we move on to JavaScript.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: You do: checklist review — header, favorites, image w/ caption, table (10 min)
Commit + push your final page (7 min)
Partner check: does your partner's page have everything? (8 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your pushed link (3 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you built your first full HTML page from scratch — structure, formatted text, an image, and a table. Next week we move on to JavaScript and start making your page do something.

6th Period.workingNow: Embedding your finished game onto your website (Share → Copy Link → Embed), then game time!
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A Sprite Lab or Game Lab project with at least three states, each triggered by an event, embedded on your website.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can embed my Game Lab project on my website so that others can see and play my finished game.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.5 — Listening actively to spoken English in a range of social and academic contexts.
agenda: Mini-lesson: how to embed — Share → Copy Link → paste into your website's embed block (5 min)
You do: embed your game on your website, confirm it displays and works (15 min)
Bank payout: game time — remaining minutes → free time (25 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday you and your partner got a third state working. Today you're publishing it — embedding your finished game right onto your website so anyone who visits can see and play it. Then it's game time!
